reason: The README clearly describes an external LLM provider plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to Gemini models through Google OAuth and Antigravity's non-public API; human review is warranted because it handles OAuth credentials and relies on an unofficial external service.

summaries.zh: 将 Google Antigravity 账号中的 Gemini 模型通过 OAuth 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供文本生成、流式响应和工具调用能力。
summaries.en: Connects Gemini models from a Google Antigravity account to DeepSeek Harness through OAuth, with text generation, streaming responses, and tool-call support.

capabilities: Integrates Gemini models into DeepSeek Harness as an LLM provider
Performs Google OAuth login and stores refresh tokens locally
Runs local OAuth callback listeners for web and CLI authentication
Sends requests to Antigravity's non-public API with streaming and tool-call support
Automatically refreshes access tokens and retries failed requests
Provides UI controls for provider activation and credential deletion
